title: Beautiful but doesn’t melt candle melts
text: Beautiful but doesn’t melt candle melts. Although it’s absolutely beautiful when plugged in and the light is on, the main feature I purchased this for failed. It doesn’t get hot enough to melt the little candle was beads. It melts maybe 1/4 of them so the room never smells good or like you have a candle burning. I’ll be returning it.
